title: Does anyone know how to make name titles like this game?

posts.author: Jasanimation
posts.body: Im a very big fan of the Project Moon games, and i really want to find a way to add name titles next to the names like this

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I guess you can use Yanfly Message Core for the name box and then something like Triacontane WindoBackImage to show a picture background. Then copy the functionality in Yanfly where it checks the name to also check for a title tag. Add the title draw line and change the coordinates where the name and title are drawn. Then I think you can set the name box rotation if you want, in initialize or refresh or whatever.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
if you want it dynamic, you need to have to rotate the text.
so you can try to modify YEP_MessageCore as given above,
another way is to use picture with the id's,  so it will be drawn by that.
but other that that, I have no idea, I did change a title plugin to add pivot
to rotate the text in an angle, which you need to create the same effect.
